description: Call this to check where the webhook of a form posts; it shows only a masked secret, so call reveal_webhook_secret when the receiving server needs the full one, and update_form_settings to set or remove the URL. Returns the webhook URL and the masked signing secret. Requires an account key (fh_live_...); agent keys answer owner_key_required.

form_id.description: The 10-character form_id returned by publish_form or list_forms, such as "abcDEF1234".

name: get_webhook

error.description: Machine-readable error code or message when the call failed.

title: Get the webhook of a form
